about_the_game:
The Void Corridors is a first-person puzzle horror game where you navigate a maze-like environment, solve intricate puzzles, and manage limited resources to survive.

Key Features:

🔦 Resource Management – Keep your flashlight powered by scavenging for energy cells, and maintain the generator to keep the corridors lit. Every second of light counts.

🧩 Puzzle Solving – Encounter a variety of environmental puzzles that unlock new areas, reveal hidden secrets, and help you progress deeper into the corridors.

🚪 Exploration & Atmosphere – Roam through dark, shifting corridors illuminated by an eerie glow. Pay attention to your surroundings—sometimes, the environment itself changes when you're not looking.

👁️ Psychological Horror – The deeper you go, the stronger the sensation of being watched. Unravel the mystery behind the corridors before the presence lurking in the shadows finds you.

Will you uncover the truth, or become lost in the void?
